title: C++: SQL Query Builder
description: Build a simple SQL query builder that constructs SELECT queries programmatically.

steps.title: Query Builder
steps.description: Create a QueryBuilder class with select(cols), from(table), and where(condition) methods that return the query string. Build: SELECT name, age FROM users WHERE age > 18.
hints: Use ostringstream to build the query.

verification.test: output.includes('SELECT name, age FROM users WHERE age > 18')
